label: HTML Block
description: Adds custom HTML/PHP and supports the compact template syntax.

properties.name: css_class
properties.label: Wrapper CSS classes
properties.help: Optional. When both wrapper classes and inline styles are empty, the HTML is emitted directly without a generated wrapper.

properties.name: inline_style
properties.label: Wrapper inline styles
properties.help: Optional. When both wrapper fields are empty, the HTML is emitted directly without a generated wrapper.

properties.name: widths
properties.label: Responsive width
properties.help: Applied only when wrapper classes or wrapper inline styles are provided.
